repository_head.description: the commit the prompt's repository pointed at when the run started, from git ls-remote, whatever each answer says it read; unknown when the command failed, and note gives the error

prompt.description: the prompt as it was typed, before the contract; two runs compare only when this text and the contract are both the same

contract.description: the contract as it was typed after the prompt, in the same message; part of what two runs must share to compare

note.description: remarks on the run as a whole: the model and effort labels the two sizes resolved to, per site, before anything was sent, and any other

url.description: the conversation's own URL, without its query string; the session id is in it. For not-signed-in and not-run, the address the tab showed, without its query string

model_label.description: the model picker's checked entry when the prompt was sent, as the list writes it ("3.1 Pro", not the chip's "Pro"); not set for not-signed-in and not-run

effort_label.description: the checked effort entry or slider stop label when the prompt was sent, as the picker writes it; none where the site has no effort control; not set for not-signed-in and not-run

started_at.description: when the prompt was sent; the moment of recording for not-signed-in and not-run

finished_at.description: when the page showed the answer complete; approximate when read off a relative time; the moment of recording for not-signed-in and not-run

read_version.description: the commit, tag, or branch and date the answer says it read, in its words; "not stated" when it names none or there is no answer

polls.description: how many times the session was polled; thirty is the bound. A session retried after an error counts the second attempt's polls only, and note gives the first attempt's

response_path.description: the saved answer, relative to the run folder

status.description: errored is the product's own error message in place of an answer, on the one retry as on the first attempt; refused is a decline; not-run is a site the skill did not send to, for the reason in note; smaller-mode is a scored answer from a smaller model, mode, or effort than the size asked for, because that one is locked on the account: model_label and effort_label are what ran, note names the locked one, and the session is left out of any like-for-like comparison

note.description: every remark on the session, in the order they arose, separated by "; "
